title: Aliquoting Amount on Cancelled Esoteric Reference Testing Accessions
content:
A cancelled Laboratory Test Orders accession of the Esoteric Reference Testing class has an aliquoting amount added to its reference-testing cancellation handling fee when more than one test stands on it.

Tests are counted from the ordered charge lines and the accepted add-on lines that have not been credited.

| Tests standing on the accession | Added to the handling fee |
|---|---|
| Four or more | 6.00 |
| Two or three | 3.00 |
| One | nothing |

**Clause.** When four or more tests stand on the accession, 6.00 is added to the handling fee for aliquoting. When two or three tests stand, 3.00 is added to the handling fee. A single test adds no aliquoting amount.

**Cases (hypothetical).** Three ordered tests and one accepted add-on, none credited: four tests, 6.00 added. The same accession after one ordered line was credited: three tests, 3.00 added.
